name: Zoned Curriculum
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Azmari EdTech: Shaping the Future, Kitara's NBN identity, which names a card type as each of the Corp's turns ends and gains 2[credit] the first time each turn the Runner plays or installs a card of the type last named. On Paid Content's list, an NBN deck with nothing outside the faction it needs. Eternal-legal only. Kitara Stage 16. Red Sand Stage 3b: two Biased Reporting for two Sweeps Week. FFG F6 Stage 5: two Special Offer, two Turnpike and two Resistor for two Pop-up Window, two Loot Box and two Matrix Analyzer, each kept by Paid Content. FFG F6 Stage 6: two Remote Data Farm, two Puppet Master and 15 Minutes for two Project Beale, two Bellona and a License Acquisition, the same eleven points, each kept by other decks.
